answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 32488 Country: INDIA Title: Some scholars say that if women has an orgasm or reaches sexual climax she should perform ghusl even if there is no discharge of fluid. Question: Some scholars say that if women has an orgasm or reaches sexual climax she should perform ghusl even if there is no discharge of fluid.I wanted to ask your opinion on this issue.It is my sincere request to please reply in english since i do not know how to read urdu. Answer ID: 32488 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 899/750/B=1432) In such case, ghusl shall not be wajib on the woman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
